title: Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.23149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. translated_title: 基于障碍引导扩散采样的异构团队能力组合
translated_abstract: 异构团队中的智能体可以通过合作来完成超越其个体能力的任务。对于合作任务，团队轨迹可以由生成模型产生，前提是该模型已在智能体合作的演示数据上完成训练。然而，合作演示数据的收集成本高昂，且对于团队从未执行过的任务，这样的演示数据可能根本不存在。但值得注意的是，智能体之间能够组合各自能力的条件是团队的物理属性，在任何演示数据被收集之前就是已知的。我们将这些条件编码为对团队轨迹的约束，并在从仅基于单个智能体演示训练的生成模型中采样时强制执行这些约束。我们证明了所提出的方法能够生成所有满足约束条件的团队轨迹，尽管演示数据中不包含任何合作行为。因此，这些约束决定了哪些团队轨迹可以被生成。
tldr: 本文提出一种障碍引导的扩散采样方法，将能力组合的物理条件编码为轨迹约束，使异构团队无需任何合作演示数据即可组合个体能力生成合作轨迹，并证明该方法能生成所有满足约束的团队轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a barrier-guided diffusion sampling method that encodes capability composition conditions as trajectory constraints, enabling heterogeneous teams to generate cooperative trajectories without any cooperative demonstrations, and proves that the method can generate every team trajectory satisfying the constraints.
